procedure: Built firmware revision 2597403 with local ESP-IDF v5.5.4 from /Users/vincenzo/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh.
Flashed the firmware to the attached ESP32-S3 DevKitC-1 on /dev/cu.usbmodem101.
Ran make IDF_PORT=/dev/cu.usbmodem101 idf-smoke-capabilities from nSealr/esp32.
Verified static fixture requests, dynamic request-id variants, invalid metadata requests, and 17 serial-wrapped invalid sign_event request vectors loaded from nSealr/specs revision c09474e.
expected_result: The device returns valid responses for capability and development public-key requests, refuses sign_event with signing_disabled, and rejects invalid metadata plus invalid sign_event request vectors with deterministic unsupported_request error frames.
observed_result: The device returned 25 protocol frames: six valid static/dynamic response frames and 19 unsupported_request error frames. The error frames covered two invalid metadata vectors and 17 serial-wrapped invalid sign_event request vectors. No parser exception, malformed_frame response, or real signing output was observed.
limitations: Protocol smoke only; no trusted display, GPIO, camera, storage, secure boot, flash encryption, debug-lock, or real signing acceptance was tested.
get_public_key uses the deterministic development fixture key, not production key custody.

sign_event is expected to remain disabled until the parser limits, trusted display review, physical approval, provisioning, storage, signed-output verification, and firmware hardening gates are complete.
